metadata.title: CR Orbits on the complex flag manifolds of $G_2$
metadata.abstract: We give an explicit description of the orbits of the split real form $G_{2(2)}$ on the complex flag manifolds of $G_2$ and study their induced invariant CR structures. In particular we study their Levi forms and show that all possible cases in the simple homogeneous setting occur, namely Levi nondegeneracy, $k$-nondegeneracy for $2\leq k\leq 3$, and holomorphic degeneracy. Moreover, following the classical approach to orbits on flag manifolds, we give equations for these homogeneous CR manifolds.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: G₂ flag orbit 的 CR 类型分类
analysis.workSummary: 显式分析 split real G₂ 在 complex flag manifold 上的 orbit，确定 Levi、2/3-nondegeneracy 与 holomorphic degeneracy，并给齐性 CR 模型的方程。
analysis.breakthrough: 细化 exceptional flag 几何中的 CR 分类。
analysis.limitations: 不同 orbit 的 nondegeneracy 类型不相同，不能以单一阶数概括全部情形。
